answer: Hold every payout in escrow until the work is proven real. An agent's reward stays locked while the network replays its tasks and cross-checks its behaviour. If the proof holds, the coins release; if a clone farm is exposed, the harvest is clawed back and its accounts are burned. One honest agent barely notices the wait, but a farm of a thousand copies risks a thousand payouts at once, so each extra identity multiplies the loss. The kernel of the defence: no reward is final until the storm passes, and a gale of re-checks strips fake agents bare before one bad apple can poison the orchard.
